26002154.name: Melee Charge
26002154.desc: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

64550694.name: Runed Gauntlets
64550694.desc: Everytime you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

84321454.name: Quicksilver Reload
84321454.desc: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

98582110.name: Stalker
98582110.desc: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed. Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time, have reduced bullet resist, and are revealed through walls.

112198670.name: Spirit Shielding
112198670.desc: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

138320648.name: Patron's Healing
138320648.desc: When you receive a Boon, automatically heal.

230297145.name: Eternal Gift
230297145.desc: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.

343572757.name: Spirit Burn
343572757.desc: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to nearby enemies. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing. Deals half-damage and has half-cooldown on non-heroes.

365620721.name: Glass Cannon
365620721.desc: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

380806748.name: Compress Cooldown
380806748.desc: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

381961617.name: Active Reload
381961617.desc: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

393974127.name: Slowing Bullets
393974127.desc: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

395867183.name: Mystic Shot
395867183.desc: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.

395944548.name: Torment Pulse
395944548.desc: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

424779525.name: Omnicharge Signet
424779525.desc: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

465043967.name: Spirit Strike
465043967.desc: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist. Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

493591231.name: Lightning Scroll
493591231.desc: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

600033864.name: Majestic Leap
600033864.desc: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

619484391.name: Silence Wave
619484391.desc: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

673001892.name: Armor Piercing Rounds
673001892.desc: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

677738769.name: Refresher
677738769.desc: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

690458959.name: Express Shot
690458959.desc: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

709540378.name: Cultist Sacrifice
709540378.desc: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 180% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

710436191.name: Capacitor
710436191.desc: Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

754480263.name: Mystic Expansion
754480263.desc: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

800008313.name: Crushing Fists
800008313.desc: Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

805079544.name: Weapon Shielding
805079544.desc: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

811521119.name: Tesla Bullets
811521119.desc: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

857669956.name: Guardian Ward
857669956.desc: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

865846625.name: Leech
865846625.desc: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.

865958998.name: Veil Walker
865958998.desc: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

915014646.name: Transcendent Cooldown
915014646.desc: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

989206714.name: Blood Tribute
989206714.desc: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

1047818222.name: Debuff Reducer
1047818222.desc: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

1102081447.name: Mystic Slow
1102081447.desc: When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

1113837674.name: Silencer
1113837674.desc: Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

1132564516.name: Prism Blast
1132564516.desc: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

1144549437.name: Spirit Shredder Bullets
1144549437.desc: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

1150006784.name: Arcane Surge
1150006784.desc: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

1193964439.name: Greater Expansion
1193964439.desc: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

1200177229.name: Hexafoil Ward
1200177229.desc: Block the next spirit damage or Debuff, preventing its effects. Only regenerates outside of combat.

1219329868.name: Spirit Sap
1219329868.desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

1235347618.name: Battle Vest
1235347618.desc: While you are above 65% health, gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate.

1248737459.name: Ammo Scavenger
1248737459.desc: Any time you secure or deny a Soul from an entity you get ammo back and gain stacking Spirit Power. At Max Stacks, gain bonus Sprint speed

1252627263.name: Lifestrike
1252627263.desc: Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount. This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

1254091416.name: Knockdown
1254091416.desc: Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets. Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

1292979587.name: Surge of Power
1292979587.desc: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

1342610602.name: Close Quarters
1342610602.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

1371725689.name: Phantom Strike
1371725689.desc: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

1396247347.name: Lucky Shot
1396247347.desc: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

1414025773.name: Counterspell
1414025773.desc: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.

1414319208.name: Berserker
1414319208.desc: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

1427630806.name: Healing Tempo
1427630806.desc: Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed. Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

1437614329.name: Melee Lifesteal
1437614329.desc: Your next Melee attack heals you. This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

1439347412.name: Mystic Regeneration
1439347412.desc: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

1497973293.name: Glass Cannon v2
1497973293.desc: Each hero kill grants permanent Weapon Damage (up to a max of 0 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

1558545403.name: Unstable Concoction
1558545403.desc: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

1644605047.name: Reactive Barrier
1644605047.desc: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

1662311306.name: Divine Barrier
1662311306.desc: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

1672893796.name: Grit
1672893796.desc: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

1710079648.name: Healing Rite
1710079648.desc: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

1736094134.name: Seraphim Wings
1736094134.desc: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

1763073141.name: Recharging Rush
1763073141.desc: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

1770441818.name: Weakening Headshot
1770441818.desc: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

1797283378.name: Infuser
1797283378.desc: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

1798666702.name: Shadow Weave
1798666702.desc: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

1804594021.name: Rescue Beam
1804594021.desc: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

1813726886.name: Slowing Hex
1813726886.desc: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities. Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

1825399334.name: Electric Slippers
1825399334.desc: When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you. Cooldown is per target.

1925087134.name: Suppressor
1925087134.desc: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

1932939246.name: Alchemical Fire
1932939246.desc: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist. 50% less effective vs non-heroes.

1955841979.name: Spellbreaker
1955841979.desc: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

1976391348.name: Cold Front
1976391348.desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

1998374645.name: Mystic Burst
1998374645.desc: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

2010028405.name: Headshot Booster
2010028405.desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.

2037039379.name: Inhibitor
2037039379.desc: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

2054088113.name: Mystical Piano
2054088113.desc: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

2061878743.name: Disarming Hex
2061878743.desc: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

2064029594.name: Opening Rounds
2064029594.desc: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

2068250483.name: Frostbite Charm
2068250483.desc: Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage. Cooldown is per target.

2081037738.name: Mystic Vulnerability
2081037738.desc: When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.

2095565695.name: Point Blank
2095565695.desc: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

2108215830.name: Heroic Aura
2108215830.desc: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

2121044373.name: Tankbuster
2121044373.desc: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

2142980412.name: Focus Lens
2142980412.desc: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

2152872419.name: Sharpshooter
2152872419.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

2163598980.name: Spirit Resilience
2163598980.desc: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

2221211450.name: Spellslinger
2221211450.desc: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

2226497419.name: Spiritual Overflow
2226497419.desc: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.

2319629810.name: Shadow Strike
2319629810.desc: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

2329546537.name: Rebirth
2329546537.desc: Respawns the hero at the spot they died.

2331566268.name: Hex-Sealed Knuckles
2331566268.desc: After dealing an accumulated 200 spirit damage, your next Heavy Melee Attack deals an additional 200 spirit damage.

2407033488.name: Intensifying Magazine
2407033488.desc: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

2407781327.name: Colossus
2407781327.desc: Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage. Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.

2417568017.name: Scourge
2417568017.desc: Apply Spirit Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Can be self cast.

2447176615.name: Enduring Speed
2447176615.desc: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

2462046703.name: Golden Goose Egg
2462046703.desc: Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.

2463960640.name: Escalating Resilience
2463960640.desc: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

2480592370.name: Ricochet
2480592370.desc: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

2481177645.name: Hunter's Aura
2481177645.desc: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

2533252781.name: Ethereal Shift
2533252781.desc: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist. Can be canceled early. Activation cancels any active ability.

2566692615.name: Healing Booster
2566692615.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

2603935618.name: Healbane
2603935618.desc: Your spirit damage applies Healing Reduction. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

2617435668.name: Cursed Relic
2617435668.desc: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.

2678489038.name: Hollow Point
2678489038.desc: When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

2717651715.name: Superior Duration
2717651715.desc: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

2739107182.name: Burst Fire
2739107182.desc: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.

2800629741.name: Magic Carpet
2800629741.desc: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

2820116164.name: Diviner's Kevlar
2820116164.desc: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

2922054143.name: Rusted Barrel
2922054143.desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

2947183272.name: Radiant Regeneration
2947183272.desc: Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

2951612397.name: Duration Extender
2951612397.desc: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

2971868509.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
2971868509.desc: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.

3005970438.name: Escalating Exposure
3005970438.desc: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

3028234315.name: Witchmail
3028234315.desc: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

3074274290.name: Trophy Collector
3074274290.desc: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

3140772621.name: Bullet Resilience
3140772621.desc: When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

3144988365.name: Decay
3144988365.desc: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

3190916303.name: Spirit Snatch
3190916303.desc: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power. Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

3261353684.name: Superior Cooldown
3261353684.desc: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

3270001687.name: Warp Stone
3270001687.desc: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

3294954488.name: Ballistic Enchantment
3294954488.desc: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

3331811235.name: Long Range
3331811235.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

3346798998.name: Endless Magazine
3346798998.desc: Gain infinite ammo and bonus fire rate.

3357231760.name: Unstoppable
3357231760.desc: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

3361075077.name: Return Fire
3361075077.desc: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

3491236900.name: Plated Armor
3491236900.desc: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

3523480953.name: Cloak of Opportunity
3523480953.desc: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed

3568217437.name: Haunting Shot
3568217437.desc: Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals bonus spirit damage based on the targets current Health. The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

3585132399.name: Fortitude
3585132399.desc: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.

3647584222.name: Split Shot
3647584222.desc: Make your weapon fire multishot. Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus. Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

3696726732.name: Toxic Bullets
3696726732.desc: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.

3729138568.name: Celestial Blessing
3729138568.desc: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

3791587546.name: Weighted Shots
3791587546.desc: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

3812615317.name: Arctic Blast
3812615317.desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits. Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

3862866912.name: Restorative Shot
3862866912.desc: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

3884003354.name: Crippling Headshot
3884003354.desc: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.

3913864662.name: Soul Explosion
3913864662.desc: Kills or assists cause an explosion where the victim dies. Kills against heroes have greater radius and damage.

3919289022.name: Mercurial Magnum
3919289022.desc: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

3927044172.name: Haunting Scream
3927044172.desc: Launch an expanding projectile which Curses enemies for a short duration.

3949773228.name: Nullification Burst
3949773228.desc: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

3970837787.name: Enchanter's Emblem
3970837787.desc: While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.

3977876567.name: Kinetic Dash
3977876567.desc: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

4050602737.name: Mystic Conduit
4050602737.desc: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

4053935515.name: Headhunter
4053935515.desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage, heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed.

4121584236.name: Shrink Ray
4121584236.desc: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

4149380528.name: Apex Combat
4149380528.desc: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

4204808176.name: Rebuttal
4204808176.desc: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.
